decision.summary: Two overlapping candidate temporary offsets in allowed context [475,699]: (1) N-dominated shift 510–544 with correlated E/U transients, lacking unambiguous return; (2) U-dominated double-dip event 520–568 with incomplete recovery. No confirmed return on any axis within context; both intervals remain uncertain.

intervals.observation: N-component shows sustained negative offset from ~510 to 544; E and U show correlated transients (U dip near 520, E transient ~515–525), but return is not clearly observed before 544—interior shows slow rebound in U but no full recovery in N/E. Status: uncertain.

U-component exhibits sharp multi-sample drop near 520 (~-2), followed by partial rebound; second abrupt dip near 550, then gradual rise through 568 without clear return to pre-event level. N/E show weaker co-transients but no definitive opposing return. Status: uncertain.
